output.summary: KEP-1729 proposes rebasing Kubernetes master and node images (core containers and addons) onto gcr.io/distroless/static:latest as the only base image, removing shell and other unsupported dependencies where needed. The KEP is in implementable status at alpha stage.
output.rationale: Images based on debian/alpine or k8s.gcr.io/debian-base must be rebuilt whenever debian-base has a vulnerability, which happens a couple of times a month, so churn in image versions is high. Rebasing to distroless/static makes images thinner, safer and less vulnerable, and reduces the number of image versions to manage. The shell dependency that justified many debian/alpine bases (glog log redirection) is no longer needed since the move to klog.

alternatives.option: Keep debian-base or alpine as the base image for all images
alternatives.why_not: The motivation notes that debian-base vulnerabilities force rebuilding every image, which causes the version churn the KEP aims to reduce.

alternatives.option: Rebase images that have hard dependencies on non-static binaries or fluentd (e.g. hyperkube)
alternatives.why_not: These are explicitly listed as Non-Goals and are not changed by this KEP.

alternatives.option: Directly change images from kubernetes incubator
alternatives.why_not: The proposal says these images won't be changed directly by this KEP; the project OWNERs decide.

evidence.quote: Use image gcr.io/distroless/static:latest as the only base image for the following kubernetes images - Images based FROM scratch
Due to the fact that many images are based on debian base and a vulnerability in debian base (a couple times a month) will result in rebuilding every image
Previously, shell is widely used for redirecting glog output to a certain directory. This use case is no longer needed since we've switched from glog to klog
Do not change images that have hard dependencies on non-static binaries.
Images from kubernetes incubator won't be changed directly by this KEP and the release plan is not estimated here.
